crossRefs.note: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…
Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?
crossRefs.keyword: vain knowledge. Heb. knowledge of wind

crossRefs.note: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
crossRefs.keyword: vain knowledge. Heb. knowledge of wind

crossRefs.note: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant…

translations.web: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
translations.bsb: “Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
translations.kjv: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
translations.asv: Should a wise man make answer with vain knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?
